questions.question:
Prachi takes Rs. 550 at 5% of simple annual interest. After 4 years, how much money will she have to pay?

A. 101

B. 606

C. 660

D. 110
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal, P = Rs. 550

Rate of interest = 5%

Time = 4 years

**Formula used:**

S.I. = P × R% × T

Amount = P + S.I.

**Calculation:**

S.I. = P × R% × T

⇒ S.I. = 550 × 5/100 × 4

⇒ S.I. = Rs. 110

Amount = P + S.I.

⇒ Amount = 550 + 110

⇒ Amount = Rs. 660

**∴ She will have to pay Rs. 660.**

There is a difference of 3 rupees in the selling price when an item is sold at a profit of 4% and 10%, then the ratio of the selling price of both is:

A. 52 ∶ 55

B. 51 ∶ 55

C. 37 ∶ 35

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit% = 4%

Increased profit% = 10%

Difference = Rs. 3

SP = (100 + Profit%) of CP

Let the CP of an item be Rs. x.

Required difference = SP at 10% – SP at 4%

⇒ 3 = (100 + 10)% of x – (100 + 4)% of x

⇒ 3 = 110/100 × x – 104/100 × x

⇒ 300 = 6x

⇒ x = Rs. 50

SP at 4% = (100 + 4)% of x

⇒ SP at 4% = 104/100 × 50

SP at 4% = Rs. 52

⇒ SP at 10% = 110/100 × 50

⇒ SP at 10% = Rs. 55
